cohort: Women with twin pregnancies who delivered two live fetuses at 20 teaching hospitals in Japan in 2014 and were eligible for planned vaginal delivery
finding: Twin vaginal deliveries were associated with slightly lower umbilical arterial pH in the second twin, while cesarean deliveries resulted in significantly greater intrapartum blood loss.
mod_finding: Twin vaginal deliveries were associated with slightly but significantly lower umbilical arterial blood pH of the second twin compared to twin cesarean deliveries.
